scheme_name: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Dance and Drama Troupes/Associations
other_conditions: The troupe must present new classical or folk dance programs or stage new dramas
The troupe/association must be a cultural body registered in the territory of Puducherry
The troupe/association must have a standing of at least two years
The theme of the dance or the story and dialogue of the drama must be new and original, created by an artist who is a native of the territory by birth or domicile
benefits_summary: Grant of ₹2,000/- is provided to eligible dance and drama troupes/associations.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self-attested, if required)
